provenance: Ren's disposition of three independent agent first-pass reviews. Acceptance means the finding warrants work, not that it is closed or that an agent can approve release.

convergence_groups.interpretation: Two independent lanes reproduced a synthetic-authority bypass. This raises remediation priority but does not merge or close either finding.
Opposite UNLESS meanings and untyped state axes are separate causes of non-reproducible condition graphs.
Population substitution and household pooling can both erase losses borne by the scoped person or cohort.
An action can look active without authority, while hard pause and reverse gates do not pre-empt act.
Unpinned inputs, weak time-series semantics and invented release times allow reproducible files to carry non-reproducible claims.

findings.rationale: The reviewer reproduced issuance using forged self-attested authority and placeholder evidence.
findings.next_test: Reject forged, revoked, out-of-scope, expired, unsigned and byte-substituted attestations at the deployment boundary.

findings.rationale: Both builders embedded undeclared canary personal data from otherwise accepted inputs.
findings.next_test: Unknown-field canaries must fail before output and a public allowlist projection must exclude undisplayed data.

findings.rationale: A reversed series passed validation and manufactured a false headline with mismatched years.
findings.next_test: Reject unordered, duplicated, misaligned, undeclared and stale-latest time series before writing output.

findings.rationale: An active action with no owner, authority, help or appeal passed and could be cropped away from caveats.
findings.next_test: Operational states require a verified action reference and adjacent complete authority metadata under crop, print and reflow.

findings.rationale: Snapshot-controlled javascript links passed and reached an href.
findings.next_test: Reject non-HTTPS and non-allowlisted source hosts in both builders.

findings.rationale: The global output lacks a conforming document shell, has known low-contrast text and no print treatment; assistive testing remains absent.
findings.next_test: Pass automated structure and contrast checks, then independent keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, reflow and print review.

findings.rationale: The product cannot encode precedence, conflicts, consent, authority or exit in its free-text playbook arrays.
findings.next_test: Typed playbook fixtures must resolve actor conflicts and preserve adjacent crisis labels, or the public deck remains hidden.

findings.rationale: Modelled poverty nowcasts are machine-labelled measured even though prose caveats say otherwise.
findings.next_test: Per-point epistemic classes must reject observed labels on modelled tails and remain visible in UI, export and crop.

findings.rationale: Frozen transformed JSON does not prove or reproduce the transformation from exact upstream bytes.
findings.next_test: Rebuild bit-for-bit from content-addressed raw inputs, response metadata and versioned adapters; reject any mutated byte.

findings.rationale: Public UNLESS means substitution while executable UNLESS means veto, which can invert a decision.
findings.next_test: Separate alternative and veto operators and exhaust all 25 five-valued state pairs for both.

findings.rationale: Lifecycle, measurement, predicate, binding and evidence states have no deterministic typed mapping.
findings.next_test: Versioned direction-aware mappings cover every valid conversion and reject ambiguous conversion.

findings.rationale: All mutually incompatible safety gates can simultaneously return true without blocking act.
findings.next_test: A deterministic resolver makes hard pause or reverse pre-empt act and unresolved safeguards block activation.

findings.rationale: LFS-family evidence is called independent despite shared inputs and incompatible geographic scope.
findings.next_test: Shared-input or geographic-substitution fixtures cannot satisfy an independent-corroboration gate.

findings.rationale: IF-05 silently changes estimand from the affected cohort to the broader local population.
findings.next_test: A Simpson's-paradox fixture leaves cohort state unknown when only the local aggregate improves.

findings.rationale: Date-only source records fabricate midnight UTC and cannot establish same-day information chronology.
findings.next_test: Verified UTC timestamps or conservative first-seen intervals resolve same-day before and after fixtures.

findings.rationale: Precision is undefined for the declared no-alert baseline, so the go rule has no decision for every allowed case.
findings.next_test: No-alert moves to utility comparison and no-event, rare-event, censoring and no-alert fixtures all resolve.

findings.rationale: Published decline rates use denominators outside the declared eligible windows.
findings.next_test: Code-generated audit output pins numerator, denominator, eligibility dates and boundary-month assignments.

findings.rationale: The machine's eight categories omit parts of G0-G10 and syntactic fiction can authorise release.
findings.next_test: Rename the result as structural eligibility and require authenticated, scoped, revocable G0-G10 attestations outside the repository.

findings.rationale: The modal master proposition can survive any negative result by adding or narrowing conditions.
findings.next_test: Bounded hypotheses preregister denominators, horizons, losses and an outcome that records a decisive negative rather than moving scope.

findings.rationale: Ecological lifecycle burden is optional even though the proposition names ecology as a required condition.
findings.next_test: Support and action fail without a scoped ecological assessment or authorised, challengeable not-material determination.

findings.rationale: The descriptive Engels' Pause survives, but the singular Factory Acts mechanism and general transition shape exceed the cited evidence.
findings.next_test: Classify each historical statement and obtain specialist review of primary causal evidence and transfer limits.

findings.rationale: Household access can rise while one member loses earnings, time, privacy, control or refusal rights.
findings.next_test: Linked household and individual fixtures enforce no-offset rules for severe individual harms without exposing sensitive data.

findings.rationale: Three Observatory layouts cannot show whether the Observatory beats a simpler statistics or deliberation design.
findings.next_test: Compare official release, release plus deliberation and Observatory plus equal deliberation, defaulting to the simpler instrument.

findings.rationale: The protocol can recruit no directly affected person and allows 27 correct plus 3 dangerous misunderstandings to pass.
findings.next_test: Separate direct and analogous strata; direct representatives own thresholds; 3 of 30 dangerous errors force revision with subgroup bounds.
